info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Model Listing API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: engineIds
params.description: The engine identifiers of the machine learning models to request.

items.docs:
Lists the organization models corresponding to the specified engine IDs.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COVEO_ML","targetDomain":"MODELS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
